# DB EXPLAIN baseline (generated by `pnpm db:explain`)

This file is generated — run against a local test database:

```powershell
docker compose up -d db                  # or any local Postgres 17
$env:TEST_DATABASE_URL = "postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/ggcb_test"
pnpm db:migrate
pnpm db:explain                          # writes this file
```

It loads ~5 000 clearly-fake synthetic alumni (`Synth Person NNNN`,
`GGCB-TEST-NNNN` — never seeded, never committed as data), then records
`EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)` plans for the five representative queries in
`scripts/explain.ts` (admin status list, filtered list, roll-number lookup,
email lookup, badge counts).

**Not yet generated:** Prompt 2 was built without a local Postgres instance
(the owner provisions Supabase directly). The baseline regenerates on the
first run of `pnpm db:explain` in any environment with a local test DB —
the safety interlock refuses non-local targets and any database name not
containing `test`.
